architecture: Buddy -> 65 MasterBots -> sub-bots -> capabilities/tools/resources -> sandbox -> benchmarks -> gap closure

placement_rules.primary_owner: Every bot has exactly one primary MasterBot owner.
placement_rules.secondary_collaborators: Cross-domain capabilities use collaborator links rather than duplicate ownership.
placement_rules.preserve_source: Grok AGI, Bots App, Real Estate and repository-specific bots remain traceable.
placement_rules.mastery_truth: A capability is mastered only after repeatable benchmark evidence is recorded.
placement_rules.runtime: Use GitHub Actions efficiently with matrix parallelism, sharding, caching, artifact reuse and priority queues; never evade platform limits.

sub_bot_policy.rule: Every discovered bot is inventoried, assigned one primary owner, linked to secondary collaborators, benchmarked where applicable, and retained as source lineage even when consolidated.

dashboard_contract.truth: Buttons must invoke real workflows or report unavailable wiring; never decorative execution claims.

training_policy.definition: Continuously maintain and prioritize each MasterBot's logical training queue; execute only when an eligible runner and budget are available.
training_policy.resource_policy: Use available public-repository Actions capacity within configured concurrency and platform limits. No quota bypass, artificial workloads, paid compute, or fabricated results.
training_policy.idle_policy: If no eligible gap or runner capacity exists, persist the queue/checkpoint and wait; do not manufacture work.

matrix_policy.selection: five consecutive canonical MasterBots selected by UTC five-minute slot; every lane gets one scheduled turn per 65-minute cycle
